text:
shreya: Heads-up — final changelog cutoff for v1.8.0 is Thu Mar 20 17:00 PT (48h from now). Please add entries to CHANGELOG.md under the release section. Use keep-a-changelog headings (Added / Changed / Fixed / Security). If you need a placeholder, add a TODO bullet and assign to me.

mike: Quick one — I have a small bugfix PR. Where should I put the bullet? Fixed or Changed?

shreya: Put it under Fixed. Single-line bullets, start with an action verb, include the PR link and issue if applicable. Example: `Fixed: handle nil cache key in kv-store (PR #1423) — closes #211`.

eva: Quick Q — do we still want a short marketing-friendly blurb somewhere (release-notes.md) or should I just add to CHANGELOG.md? I can draft a one-liner.

shreya: Yes please — add `releases/release-notes/v1.8.0.md` with a 1-2 sentence blurb following the template: `Short summary. Impact. Migration/upgrade note if any. CTA (e.g., upgrade link)`.

ollie: Branching note: code freeze for master -> release cut is at 18:00 PT today. If your PR isn't merged by then, open a backport PR against `release/v1.8.0`. No new features after cutoff unless behind a feature-flag and agreed with product.

mike: Will prioritize review queue now. @eva can you take a look at #1482 (small perf tweak)?

release-bot: :bell: CHANGELOG.md updated by @mike in PR #1490 (merged 30m ago).

shreya: Thanks — one nit on that PR: move the bullet from `Changed` -> `Fixed` (it is a bug fix). I'll move it if nobody objects.

mike: go for it, thanks.

shreya: For convenience, here's the changelog bullet format we prefer (drop into your PR description or CHANGELOG.md):

```
### [1.8.0] - 2026-03-20
#### Added
- Added: support for prioritized routing keys for Dedicated pools (PR #1468)

#### Fixed
- Fixed: handle nil cache key in kv-store (PR #1423) — closes #211

#### Changed
- Changed: default autoscale timeout from 60s -> 45s (PR #1475)

#### Security
- Security: sanitize user-provided metadata on model uploads (PR #1501)
```

shreya: TL;DR: short bullets, PR links, correct section. If you can't edit CHANGELOG.md directly, leave a comment in your PR with the exact bullet text and assign me. I’ll sweep before the cut.

eva: I'll draft the marketing blurb and drop it in `releases/release-notes/v1.8.0.md` by EOD.

ollie: Reminder to reviewers — if you request changes that will push past cutoff, mark the review as `needs-backport` so we can track it.

mike: Done — merged #1482, added changelog bullet and linked here.

release-bot: :white_check_mark: Release checklist updated: version bump to `1.8.0` pending final changelog confirmation.

shreya: Awesome, thanks everyone. I’ll do a final sweep 30m before cutoff and send the release notes to marketing for signoff. If anything blocks, @shreya will escalate.
